newsitem.title: USA: Key U.S. stock index futures extend gains late.
newsitem.headline: Key U.S. stock index futures extend gains late.

text.p: July 8 - Key U.S. stock index futures extended gains late, to new session peaks. Sept S&P 500 futures hit daily high of 928.00, but still within Monday's range. Traders cite better-than-expected Intl Paper earnings, optimism before Motorola results. Trade turns brisk after otherwise quiet afternoon, traders said.
